d: Sausage Cassoulet - Jamie shows how to cook kinda sausage cassoulet, warm broccoli salad and berry and custard pie.
Jamie kicks things off by celebrating vegetables in a game-changing cottage pie, amazing Indian street food, brilliant chip butty, and pad thai that has been transformed into a meat-free feast!
Jamie continues the veggie craze as he cooks vegetarian chili, Indian spiced parsnip soup, meat-free pasties, and a unique cauliflower cheese you've never seen before.
Jamie gets the veg party started with a bold black bean burger followed by a charred, crunchy salad with the coolest croutons, flavorful curry singing with spices, and veggie carbonara.
Jamie showcases vegetables with his easy scruffy aubergine lasagne, an incredible bean salad, some crispy-bottomed steamed dumplings, and a show-stopping cauliflower roast.

Jamie gets things going by turning out a show-stopping sticky onion tart, creamy coconut pumpkin rice, spicy butter bean stew, Indian aubergine, and crunchy roast new potatoes with a super-cool pickle.

Jamie celebrates beautiful vegetables with a creamy risotto with roasted tomato, pancakes supercharged with spinach, cheese and chili, summer veg pie, and asparagus quiche buddied up with a sublimely silky soup.
In this Christmas special, Jamie will be cooking up a bunch of epic dishes for the festive season.
